5 توسّد , (L, K,) and توسّد وِسَادًا, or وِسَادَةً (L,) and شَيْئًا, (S,) He put for himself a pillow, (L, K,) and a thing, (S,) beneath his head; (S, L,) he rested his head upon a pillow. (L.) ―
-b2- توسّد ذِرَاعَهُ He made his fore arm his pillow; i. e., lay upon his fore arm, putting it as a pillow. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
